credential_capture.label: USDA FoodData Central API key (optional)
credential_capture.description: Optional. A free USDA FoodData Central API key improves nutrition-lookup coverage and rate limits for products the Whole Foods product page does not have nutrition facts for. Leave blank to use the public rate-limited DEMO_KEY.

fields.name: usda_api_key
fields.label: USDA FoodData Central API key
fields.help_text: Get a free key at https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/api-key-signup. Without one, nutrition lookups use the shared DEMO_KEY, which is more rate-limited.

refresh_policy.rationale: Whole Foods (via Amazon) frequently requires OTP and triggers bot-detection; refresh manually.

streams.name: profile
streams.description: The Amazon account used to place Whole Foods orders.

display.label: Your Amazon account
display.detail: Name and email of the Amazon account whose order history was scraped.

display.label: Your Whole Foods orders
display.detail: Order date, order URL, total, item count, status. Uses your Amazon login.

streams.name: order_items
streams.description: Items within Whole Foods orders, each with a source Amazon product ID. Nutrition joins on `product_id`.

streams.name: nutrition
streams.description: Exactly one nutrition row per ordered product per run, keyed by `product_id` and joinable to `order_items`. `status` says what the lookup concluded: `matched` (facts from Amazon, Whole Foods or USDA FoodData Central) or `not_found`, `error`, `blocked` (no facts). Fact fields are valid only when `status` is `matched`. The connector keeps no per-key state and a non-matched row has the same key as a matched one, so a store that upserts by key lets a later non-matched row replace an earlier matched row: consumers MUST NOT apply the fact fields of a row whose `status` is not `matched`. This is not new: connector 0.3.34 already emits same-key failure rows (`source` = not_found, error or blocked); splitting outcomes into their own stream is a separate, pending decision. Rows stored before `status` and `cause` existed have neither; read their status from `source` (`not_found`, `error` or `blocked` for a failure, otherwise matched).

display.label: Nutrition facts
display.detail: A nutrition row for every ordered product: facts when a full panel was read, otherwise the reason there are none (not found, could not be read, or blocked). Facts of a row that was not matched must not replace stored facts.

status.description: What the lookup concluded. Facts are valid only when `matched`. Absent on rows stored before this field existed.

cause.description: Stable reason code for a non-matched row; null on a matched row. blocked: robot_check (a captcha or robot check). error: http_error (a page answered HTTP 4xx/5xx other than 404/410), navigation_failed (a page read threw), unrecognized_page (a 200 page that is not a known product or search page), identity_conflict (a page that cannot be this product: another ASIN, order or origin, or an ambiguous main product), identity_unbound (a page with no identity evidence to bind it to this product), panel_partial (this product's panel was seen but not fully read), usda_request_failed (the USDA lookup failed). not_found: no_match (every source answered and none had a usable panel). When several sources fail, robot_check wins, otherwise the first failure.
